# Morite

> OEM / ODM electric bicycle manufacturer in Changzhou, China. Nine e-bike platforms for distributors, private-label brands and fleet buyers.

## Products
- [X-tron](https://morite-power.com/products/x-tron.html): Full aluminium city frame, 16" or 20" wheels, 48V 500W rear hub drive.
- [Tycoon](https://morite-power.com/products/tycoon.html): 16"×4.0" fat tyres, hydraulic disc brakes, removable 48V battery.
- [EQ MAG](https://morite-power.com/products/eq-mag.html): Samsung 20Ah or 10Ah pack, carbon steel frame, up to 60 km of range.
- [Moped](https://morite-power.com/products/moped.html): 27 kg step-through commuter with 350W or 500W geared drive.
- [Artax Li](https://morite-power.com/products/artax-li.html): Dual or single battery, Shimano 7-speed, Tektro hydraulic brakes.
- [Gravel GX](https://morite-power.com/products/gravel-gx.html): 700C platform, 10-speed drivetrain, 19.6 kg complete bike.
- [Supermini](https://morite-power.com/products/supermini.html): 18" city mini with 70–80 km range and 4-speed gearing.
- [Electric Folding](https://morite-power.com/products/folding.html): 16" or 20" folding frame, Shimano 7-speed, 70–80 km range.
- [BELUGA](https://morite-power.com/products/beluga.html): 20"×4.25" fat tyres, Shimano 7-speed, 32 km/h top speed.
